pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit highly irregular, stellate geometry with frequent sharp-angled protrusions and deeply serrated edge gradients. Spatial area of individual patches varies from moderate on the mid-flank to smaller on the posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light pelage forms a continuous topological network of pathways. Corridors exhibit variable pixel thickness due to the jagged nature of bordering patch edges. Multiple junction nodes are visible where three or four corridor pathways intersect.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane along the upper neck and shoulder exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the light-colored background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian symbiont (oxpecker) on the anterior shoulder region, creating a localized dark textural disruption against the light corridor.
